section2.title: Your share of work for Silverstone
section2.guidance:
This section helps determine the most appropriate and accurate method for calculating the greenhouse gas emissions associated with your supply to Silverstone.

Depending on your business type and the information you already have available, there are three possible reporting approaches:

- **Product-specific emission factors (PCF/EPD):**  
  Used when you already know the measured carbon footprint of the specific products supplied to Silverstone.

- **Configured product emission factors:**  
  Used when you supply physical goods but do not have your own carbon footprint data. In this case, Experienz will apply industry-standard emission factors based on the products and quantities you provide.

- **Operational emissions allocation (Scope 1 & 2):**  
  Used when your business is primarily service-based, when your activities cannot easily be broken into individual products, or when you already track company-wide operational emissions and prefer to allocate a proportion to Silverstone.

To ensure emissions are not double-counted, please select only the approach that best represents your supply to this event.

Where operational allocation is used, the questionnaire will ask for:

- your preferred allocation methodology,
- the relevant reporting period,
- and the proportion of your annual operations associated with Silverstone.

Please ensure that any operational emissions, energy consumption, financial figures, and allocation calculations relate to the same reporting year wherever possible.

question1778054124442.helpText:
Product-Specific Emission Factor

An **emission factor** measures the carbon dioxide (CO2) released to create one unit of a product. While standard emission factors use generic industry averages, a **product-specific emission factor** is calculated for that exact item.

These precise figures are found in verified sustainability documents, such as:
* **PCF** (Product Carbon Footprint)
* **EPD** (Environmental Product Declaration) Ã¢â‚¬â€œ *Third-party verified*

**In practice:** Instead of using a generic estimate for "bread," a supplier can provide their exact certified calculation (e.g., 1 kg of sourdough = 0.85 kg CO2).

section4.title: Allocated Operational Emissions (Scope 1 & 2)
section4.guidance:
**What is this module?**
For suppliers who calculate their own Scope 1 & 2 emissions. Provide annual totals - Silverstone calculates event share.

**Who completes this?**
Only if you selected "No, I'd prefer operational emissions" AND answered "Yes, calculates Scope 1 & 2" in Section 2. Otherwise skip to energy data.

**What to enter:**
- **Scope 1 Emissions** - annual direct emissions (fuel, generators, vehicles, leaks) in tonnes CO2e.
- **Scope 2 Location-Based** - annual purchased electricity using grid rates in tonnes CO2e.
- **Scope 2 Market-Based** - purchased electricity via renewables (REGOs only). Leave blank if N/A.
- **Reporting Standard** - tick framework (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1, SECR, CDP, SBTi, other).
- **Verification Status** - tick verified, self-assessed, in progress, or none.
- **Emission Factor Database** - tick source (DEFRA, Ecoinvent, GaBi, other).

---

section5.title: Allocated Energy Consumption Data
section5.guidance:
**What is this module?**
For suppliers who don't calculate Scope 1 & 2 emissions. Provide raw annual energy consumption - Silverstone applies factors and calculates event share.

**Who completes this?**
Only if you answered "No, company does not calculate Scope 1 & 2" in Section 2. If "Yes", complete Module 0A instead.

**What to enter:**
- **Energy Type** - select: Natural gas, Diesel, Petrol, LPG, Fuel oil, Electricity, or other.
- **Quantity** - enter amount (kWh for electricity/gas, litres for fuels, m3 for volume).
- **Unit** - select unit (kWh, litres, m3, kg, tonnes).
- **Renewable %** - if REGO-backed, enter percentage. Leave blank for standard grid.
- **Add one row per energy type** - if you used diesel, gas, electricity, complete three rows.
- **Use annual figures** for 12-month period in Section 2, not event estimates.

---

section6.title: Food & Beverage
section6.guidance:
**What is this module?**
For suppliers providing food or beverages. Report quantities - Silverstone calculates carbon footprint using standard factors.

**Who completes this?**
Only if you selected "Food & Beverage Services" as Primary or Secondary in Section 1.

**What to enter:**
- **Food Category** - select type (Beef, Chicken, Cheese, Bread, Vegetables, Sandwiches, Ice cream, etc.).
- **Quantity Supplied** - enter amount for this event only (not annual).
- **Unit** - select kg, units, meals, or portions.
- **Refrigeration** - tick Yes-Chilled, Yes-Frozen, No, or N/A (affects carbon).
- **PCF Value** - only if you selected "Yes, own factors" in Section 2. Otherwise leave blank.
- **PCF Standard** - only if you provided PCF value above.
- **Beverages** - complete table for drinks (beer, wine, soft drinks, coffee, tea, etc.).
- **Add rows** - click "+ Add Row" for more products.

---

section9.guidance:
**What is this module?**
For suppliers who arranged and paid for delivery. Report transport details - Silverstone calculates carbon footprint.

**Who completes this?**
Only if you answered "Yes, arranged and paid for delivery" in Section 2. If Silverstone arranged, skip.

**What to enter (all modes):**

- **Weight (t)** - total weight.
- **Trips** - number of deliveries/shipments/flights.
- **Return Status** - if delivery exclusive to Silverstone.
- **Load Factor %** - if delivery exclusive to Silverstone.
- **Add rows** - click "+ Add Row" for each route/mode.

**Road:** Mode, Fuel Type, Actual Fuel (L if known).

**Rail:** Weight per Trip.

**Sea:** Mode (Cargo Ship, Tanker, etc.).

**Air:** Mode (Domestic, Short-haul, Long-haul, International).

section16.title: Module 5A: Waste
section16.guidance:
**What is this module?**
For suppliers managing own waste. Report type and quantity - Silverstone calculates carbon footprint by disposal method.

**Who completes this?**
Only if "No" to "Is waste removed by Silverstone's contractor?" If "Yes", Silverstone handles it.

**Gateway:**

**Is waste removed by Silverstone's site contractor?**
- **Yes** - skip data table (Silverstone handles).
- **No** - complete waste data table.

**What to enter (if No):**
- **Waste Type** - select (Food, Paper, Plastics, Glass, Metal, Wood, Construction, Residual, etc.).
- **Quantity (tonnes)** - amount of this type.
- **Treatment Method** - select: Landfill, Recycling (Open/Closed), Combustion, Composting, Anaerobic digestion.
- **Diversion %** - % diverted from landfill (e.g., 80).
- **Distance (km)** - distance to treatment facility.
- **Add rows** - click "+ Add Row" per waste type.

section18.title: On-Site Energy, Power & Equipment Use
section18.guidance:
**What is this module?**
Report fuel or electricity your equipment consumed at Silverstone - Silverstone calculates carbon footprint.

**Who completes this?**
Only if "Yes" to "Did equipment consume fuel/electricity?" If "No", skip.

**Gateway:**

**Did equipment consume fuel or electricity?** Yes/No. If Yes, continue.

**Where did energy come from?**
- **Silverstone-provided** - skip table (already in Silverstone Scope 1/2).
- **Self-supplied** - you brought fuel/generator. Complete table.
- **Mixed** - some Silverstone, some yours. Complete for your portion.

**What to enter (if Self-supplied or Mixed):**
- Energy Type: Generator, Grid, Temporary, Solar, Battery, Hybrid, Other.
- Operates: Self or Silverstone.
- Fuel Type: Diesel, Petrol, HVO, LPG, Gas, etc.
- Fuel (L): amount.
- Electricity (kWh): if used.
- Renewable %: REGO tariff percent.
- Generator Hours: audit.
- Refrigerant: HFC-134a, R410A, CO2, etc.
- Leakage (kg): if known.
- Add rows per energy type.

---
